_notes: Numeric ranges: logical order min–max with an en dash (U+2013) and Western digits, no LTR isolate; in RTL rendering the minimum sits on the right and the reader reads it right-to-left (0–9 displays as 9–0 visually, read 'from 0 to 9'), which is the native Arabic convention — the V31 screenshots (pricing/addons-ar-1440.png) are correct as rendered. Formatter-made ranges ({{min}}–{{max}}, {{from}} – {{until}}, {{range}}) were left as they are. In running prose a range is spelled out as «من سنتين إلى ثلاث سنوات» (degreeSub.ASSOCIATE, prior.level.ASSOCIATE) because that is how a Saudi reader expects it in a sentence; compact labels keep the dash (bands 0–9, 0–120, levels 1–6).

plan: unified to «الباقة / الباقات» everywhere (student v17.gate.*, v17.pay/upgrade and all mobile:plan.* / more.* said «خطة» or «خطة دعم»); «خطة» collides with «خطة الدراسة» (study plan) and «خطة التكاليف», and «باقة» is already the term in marketing/common ar files. «هانغيول» (transliterated brand in v17.gate.named) restored to Latin «Hangyul».

personal statement = «البيان الشخصي», study plan = «خطة الدراسة» (one term each; v15/v17/mobile:plan said «المقال», «تنقيح البيان», «مراجعة المقال»). writing.subtitle rewritten because «البيانات الشخصية» reads as 'personal data'.

Document verification by the team = «التحقق من المستند»; «توثيق» was dropped for that action in every agency/reviews string because in Saudi usage توثيق means notarization (it is already used for the notary in v15.services.external). Document review state = «قيد المراجعة» (was «قيد الفحص» / «قيد التحقق» in three places). Authentication of a document = «تصديق» with the official forms «أبوستيل» and «تصديق قنصلي».

application requirement = «الشروط (المنشورة)»; «المتطلبات» aligned in the two student/mobile strings that differed. managed application = «الطلبات التي نقدّمها معك» (says what we do); university recommendation = «الجامعات الموصى بها» (avoids «توصيات الجامعات», readable as 'the universities' recommendations'); visa document preparation = «تجهيز مستندات التأشيرة»; help after arrival = «المساعدة بعد وصولك»; standard admission letter = «خطاب القبول القياسي» as already used in mobile.

mobile number = «رقم الجوال» (Saudi usage; strings mixed «رقم الهاتف المحمول» and «جوال»). Student-facing «مستشارك» replaced by «فريق Hangyul (Univ)» per the V22 team identity and the English; staff-facing strings that say counselor in English (university.applicants.confirmBody, v3.uni.requestWho, v3.agency.waitingOn.counselor) keep «المستشار».

Plurals: every family in the job now carries _zero/_one/_two/_few/_many/_other where the Arabic form differs (dual, 3–10 plural, 11–99 accusative singular with tanween, 100+ singular); forms identical to _other were not added. The RLM (U+200F) prefix already used on placeholder-led strings was kept. Count-neutral strings that carry {{count}} without a plural family (student.nextAction.PROFILE_UNLOCK.* «{{count}} برنامجًا», v29.plan.supportDays, v3.uni.closed «{{min}} أشخاص», att.overSla, reviews.summary) cannot be made correct for 3–10 without a family — owner to decide whether to add families in code.

Removed content not in the English: Android-emulator instructions in mobile:login.networkError, 'items transferred / retention period' in both CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION summaries, 'common and comfortable start' in degreeSub.LANGUAGE, 'on this server' in v3.messages.attachUnavailable. No promise was added; «الحصول على تأشيرة الطالب» (stageLine.visa, 'obtaining') became «تجهيز» (preparing) per the glossary rule.
